scope: Static inventory of public module-level functions in seven legacy toolbox modules; no imports or algorithm execution.
counting_rule: Count top-level FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef with names not beginning with underscore; exclude private/nested functions and class methods.
notes: E identifies five legacy entry points with existing core coverage, not complete behavioral equivalence.
The current nine MCP tools are not nine one-to-one migrated legacy functions; do not use 133-9.
M preserves reusable capabilities by composition or shared primitives; it does not mean deletion.
N excludes an independent general-purpose GIS endpoint; retain legacy source or use a workflow/plugin when justified.
P1/P2/X are priority and scope recommendations, not evidence of implementation readiness or numeric correctness.
Proposed names, batches and counts are design candidates, not registered tools or a release commitment.
source_path_base: Original GABench repository root; provenance only, not a runtime dependency of this document.
